title: Describing Your Weekend
text: Last weekend, I went to the countryside with my classmates. The weather was beautiful and we had a picnic near the river. It was a really relaxing experience.

title: Making a Suggestion
text: How about going to the new mall this Saturday? We could watch a movie and then have dinner together. If you prefer, we can also visit the science museum instead. What do you think?

title: Talking About Healthy Habits
text: Staying healthy is very important to me. I try to exercise three times a week and eat a balanced diet. I believe that good habits, like sleeping early and drinking enough water, make a big difference in daily life.

title: Discussing Career Plans
text: After I graduate, I want to work in marketing because I enjoy being creative. I plan to gain some experience at a small company first, then move to a larger firm.

title: Expressing Opinions About Education
text: I think online learning is becoming more popular and useful. Students can study at their own pace and choose from a wide range of courses from anywhere in the world.

title: Talking About a Memorable Trip
text: The most memorable trip I have ever taken was to Yunnan province. I was amazed by the beautiful scenery and the diverse cultures. I would love to go back someday.

title: Discussing Environmental Issues
text: Air pollution is a serious problem in many cities. Governments should encourage people to use public transportation and develop renewable energy sources to protect the environment.

title: Sharing a Personal Experience
text: Last summer, I volunteered at a local school in a rural area. I taught children English and played games with them. It was one of the most rewarding experiences of my life.

title: Talking About Technology Use
text: Social media helps me stay connected with friends who live far away. However, I sometimes spend too much time scrolling through my phone and realize I need a digital detox.

title: Discussing Cultural Differences
text: People in different countries have very different customs and traditions. For example, in some cultures it is polite to remove your shoes before entering a home, while in others it is not necessary.

title: Talking About Financial Planning
text: I try to save at least twenty percent of my salary every month. I think it is important to set aside money for emergencies and future goals like buying a house.

title: Describing a Favorite Book
text: The book I enjoyed the most is called The Old Man and the Sea. It tells the story of a fisherman who never gives up. I was deeply inspired by his determination and courage.

title: Talking About Relationships
text: I believe trust and communication are the most important things in any relationship. Without them, even the strongest friendship or romance can quickly fall apart over small misunderstandings.

title: Discussing Sports and Fitness
text: I started playing badminton last year and it has become my favorite sport. It is a great way to stay fit and meet new people. I usually play twice a week after work.

title: Giving Advice About Stress
text: When I feel stressed, I usually go for a long walk or listen to calming music. I have found that taking short breaks during the day really helps me stay focused and relaxed.

title: 交通方式
text: I get to work by bike. It takes about thirty minutes.

title: 介绍职业
text: My father is a doctor. He works very hard.

title: 健康饮食
text: For lunch I usually have noodles. It is healthy.

title: 城市生活
text: I live in Tokyo. It is a big and busy city.

title: 旅行计划
text: I plan to visit London next month with my family.

title: 工作描述
text: As a manager, I have many tasks to finish every day.

title: 兴趣爱好
text: My hobby is basketball. I do it every week.

title: 日常安排
text: I get up at eight every morning and drink a cup of tea.
